workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: The top-level isolation boundary. Underneath, the self-developed SKE distribution automatically maps it to Namespace + Quota + NetworkPolicy — customers never worry about containers or orchestration.
workspaces.emptyHint: There are no workspaces under the current tenant. Click "+ New Workspace" in the top right to create the first one.

overview.mappingNote: Automatically mapped to Namespace + ResourceQuota + NetworkPolicy (deny-all) underneath.

members.maintainNote: The underlying Namespace + ResourceQuota + NetworkPolicy (deny-all) is automatically translated and maintained by the encapsulation layer.
members.planNote: Member and role management is on the product roadmap (requires integration with the tenant identity source Keycloak). The current version provides no placeholder data.
